card.name: Past-versus-present time contrast words
card.fires_on: Time words that set a past state against the present, such as 'traditionally', 'historically', 'recently', and 'have' in 'still have' or 'have had'. They usually come in a sentence that contrasts then and now.

modes.label: Past-tradition adverbs
modes.description: Adverbs like traditionally, historically or recently that begin a statement about how things used to be.
modes.example: Ancestral descent is traced through the mother, and,<< traditionally>>, a young couple moved into the bride

modes.label: Have after still/currently
modes.description: The verb have or had after 'still' or 'currently have or' in a past-and-present pairing.
modes.example: Etonogestrel and ethinyl estradiol vaginal ring is contraindicated in females who currently have or have<< had>> breast cancer
